ns2:section.sectionText: This section has combined evening exams. See https://math.illinois.edu/academics/courses/timetable for the schedule. This section has a blended format in which part of the content is delivered in lecture and discussion, and part is delivered online. This course is restricted to the College of ACES until June 25, 2018 at 2:00 pm. Current Agri-Communication majors should e-mail mathadvising@illinois.edu with name, major, and UIN for a College override.
